verdict.rationale: Terminal emulators can plausibly ship AI features that consume MCP servers, so this axis applies to kitty. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions MCP or kitty calling external tool servers. Its documented remote control (`kitten @`) works the other way: external scripts or agents drive kitty. That is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
